args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

Affected: <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4. Bump the pin to 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.
- fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

Reviewer: @alex (code-owner approval required for merge to main).
